description:
## What to do

Adapt the upstream TUI components doc (tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/tui.md, 918 lines) for our Elixir system.

## Upstream source

- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/tui.md
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/src/ (all TUI components)

## Output

Create docs/tui.md

## How to adapt

1. **Component Interface**: Convert the TypeScript Component interface to our Elixir behaviour:
   ```elixir
   @callback render(width :: non_neg_integer) :: [String.t()]
   @callback handle_input(data :: String.t()) :: :ok
   @callback wants_key_release() :: boolean
   @callback invalidate() :: :ok
   ```

2. **Focusable Interface**: Convert the Focusable interface for IME support.

3. **Using Components**: Convert the extension API to our Elixir equivalent:
   ```elixir
   # In an extension:
   pi.on("session_start", fn _event, ctx ->
     handle = ctx.ui.custom(my_component)
     # handle.request_render() / handle.close()
   end)
   ```

4. **Container Components**: Document our Elixir container components.

5. **Building Blocks**: Document our Elixir building block components:
   - `Box` — bordered container
   - `Text` — styled text
   - `Divider` — horizontal rule
   - `Column` / `Row` — layout containers
   - `Markdown` — markdown rendering
   - `Overlay` — floating overlay
   - `SelectList` — selectable list
   - `Input` — text input
   - `Editor` — multi-line editor
   - `AssistantMessage` — assistant message display
   - `ToolExecution` — tool call display
   - `BashExecution` — bash output display
   - `UserMessage` — user message display

6. **Custom Tool Renderers**: Document how to register custom renderers.

## What to preserve verbatim

- The component interface concept
- The Focusable/IME support concept
- The container layout concepts
- The building block descriptions (adapted to Elixir)

## Key upstream references to include

- [tui.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/tui/src/tui.ts)
- [components/](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/tree/main/packages/tui/src/components/)

## Testing the doc

After writing, verify:
1. All component names match our actual components
2. The behaviour callbacks match our actual API
3. The component API is accurate
